plan.title: Recreate Order with Next-Month Delivery Date

steps.note: Open the prepared closed RFQ specified by the setup case.
Enable the required eRFX project configuration before accessing the closed RFQ flow.
Open the RFQ stage settings and launch the Recreate Order dialog.
Verify that the Recreate Order pop-up opened.
Verify that the dialog exposes the delivery-date field required by the case.
Select a delivery date in the following month.
Capture the selected date so it can be compared with the vendor-facing view.
Create the recreated order using the selected delivery date.
Verify that creating the order did not produce an application error.
Move to the invited vendor's supplier-portal session to inspect the vendor-facing result.
Open the newly recreated event's vendor overview.
Compare the vendor-facing delivery date with the date selected in the recreate dialog.
